Good afternoon, and welcome to Hotel Le Marais. Do you have a reservation?
Yes, I do. My name is Thaís Ferreira, and the room is for three people.
Ferreira, room four zero two. Is this your first trip to Paris?
Yes, it is. My husband and my daughter are with me. We travel together.
Very good. Are you here for work?
No, I am not. I don't travel for work this time. This trip is for my family.
That is wonderful. Here is your key, and a map of our street.
Thank you. Excuse me, is there a bathroom near the elevator?
Yes, there is. It is on the left, next to the small green door.
Perfect. And where is the metro station?
It is on this street, two minutes on foot. Have a very good day in Paris.

Good afternoon, and welcome to Paris. My name is Antoine, and I am your driver today. The trip to your hotel is about forty minutes, because the street near the river is very busy. Your hotel is in the Marais, and it is a very good area for a family. There is a big park two minutes from the hotel, and there are many small restaurants on the same street. If you are cold, please tell me and I close the window. Sit back, and enjoy the city. Paris is beautiful in October.

Hello, and welcome to your room. This is a short message from the reception. My name is Elodie, and I work here in the afternoon. Breakfast is on the first floor, from seven to ten, every day. There is a small kitchen next to the breakfast room, with water and coffee, and it is open all day. If you need a taxi, please call the reception and we call one for you. The metro station is very near, but the street is busy in the morning, so please walk together with your family. Have a very good first day in Paris.
